title: Small bias scale bounded by output scale
statement: Let $k,n,N,D$ be nonnegative integers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $0<N$, and $2N\le D$. Define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, the size scale $S=k(d+1)$, and the reciprocal scale $R=\lceil D/N\rceil$. Then the scale $\lceil nD/N\rceil$ is at most the output scale $SR$.
